title: An Lushan Rebellion begins
shortSummary: War beginning in 755 disrupted the two capitals and changed the demographic, fiscal and institutional environment of religious life.
curatorialDescription: The event is a structural turning point; a single rise-and-decline narrative cannot replace regional differences.
researchNote: Effects on Chang'an, Luoyang and regional religious and educational institutions require place- and period-specific evidence.
